meta.source: research round 2026-09-10 — CN round 43: HANDOFF 084 §3 [Agent] items 1-4 — the hotel star-rating standard, the departmental-listing grep, the hazardous-waste list, Guangdong's unbracketed indicators layer
meta.note: Round 43, Thomas's brief: 'go ahead with what you can, i will answer the questions after' (the two [Thomas] items of HANDOFF 084 §3 are untouched). RESULT: 3 nodes, 3 edges — fewer than the handoff projected, and the reasons are recorded here rather than smoothed over. ITEM 1 (旅游饭店星级的划分与评定): the handoff's SAMR URL (gbDetailed?id=8CC164ED81FAC57EE05397BE0A0A9BED) is the 2020 REVISION PROJECT page (国家标准项目 20201806-T-357), not the standard; the platform's query API returns three editions with their own pages — GB/T 14308-2003 (废止), GB/T 14308-2010 (id 71F772D7D1A7D3A7E05397BE0A0AB82A, 废止 2024-03-01) and GB/T 14308-2023 (现行 from 2024-03-01). The national yearbook's zb17 names the 2010 edition WITH its number, so that is the node (cn-gbt-14308-2010, the GB/T 4754-2017 shape: a real edition with its own number). Suzhou's zb16 names the title BARE, and with the 2023 edition in force for the 2024 data year a bare title cannot say which edition it means — refused on the COICOP/三次产业划分规定 edition-inference ground, recorded below. 'Xi'an' as a third citation was a bad record: all 22 of Xi'an's zbNN.pdf plus sm16/sm17 were fetched and grepped this round and none names the standard. So ONE edge, not three. ITEM 2 (the departmental-listing grep): no yearbook text survives from earlier rounds, so the national sm+zb layers, Shandong sm+zb, Hunan zb, Suzhou zb, Xi'an zb and Guangdong's 47 CD-edition pages were re-fetched and every title of the 512-entry listing (bmzd_all.tsv, parenthetical editions stripped) was matched against them WITHOUT requiring 《》. ONE hit, never recorded by any round: national sm04's 资料来源 says 城镇登记失业人员数据，是人力资源社会保障部根据其《人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度》整理提供 — node minted off the listing's 2025-06-04 entry, one uses_data_from edge. The five 'known unwired hits' (教育事业综合, 民政事业, 海关, 全国卫生健康监督, 交通运输综合) are named by NONE of the texts scanned; they are listing entries with no citing yearbook, and the note that listed them said as much. ITEM 3 (国家危险废物名录): the national zb08 cites the 2016 EDITION by year — 按《国家危险废物名录》（2016）填报 — not the 2021 edition the handoff named. Four editions exist (2008 令第1号, 2016 令第39号, 2021 令第15号, 2025 令第36号), each a new 令 replacing the last, so the node is the 2016 edition and a dated citation reaches it. MEE's own 2016 page (/gkml/hbb/bl/201606/t20160621_354852.htm) now 302s to MEE's 404; MEE's 规章库 carries only the 2025 edition; the State Council Gazette (国务院公报 2016年第26号, gov.cn) prints 令第39号 in full with the three ministers' signatures and is the node URL on the 对外承包工程管理条例 precedent, caveat on the node. Jiangsu's nj0914 (read in the built-in browser; the container is Knownsec-blocked on tj.jiangsu.gov.cn today) cites the title BARE inside the 固体法 definition of 一般工业固体废物 — refused on the same edition ground as Suzhou's hotel citation. So ONE edge, not two. ITEM 4 (Guangdong's indicators.html unbracketed names): the zip came down complete with `curl -C -` on the second try (21,520,465 bytes); all 23 indicators.html and 24 brief-description.html were scanned for 制度/办法/规定/方案/条例/标准/规范/名录/准则 without brackets. Nothing new: the unbracketed mentions are 国家统计局农业统计报表制度 (ch11) and 国家统计局工业统计报表制度 (ch12) — the 农业产值/工业统计 look-alike class, refused on title mismatch as before — plus generic 国家统计调查制度 / 各有关专业统计报表制度. Settled negative; the layer is done. Chrome extension was not connected this session; the built-in browser pane read Jiangsu. Grades are the grader's unless the basis says otherwise. ALSO CLOSED: the national yearbook's zb10.pdf and zb27.pdf, 'unread' in HANDOFF §3 since round 38 (corrupt xref, 404), both fetched clean this round and neither names any instrument (固定资产投资 and 澳门 indicator definitions). LATER THE SAME SESSION — Thomas ruled on both [Thomas] items: (1) KEEP the 文物文化 alias (round 42's node description updated to say so); (2) 《企业会计准则》 IS a node — the basic standard, minted here as cn-mof-enterprise-accounting-standards off the 国务院公报 printing of 令第76号 (mof.gov.cn 502'd on every route today), wired to Suzhou, Guangdong and Xi'an off the sentences that already carry the 小企业会计准则 edges. 4 nodes, 6 edges in this slice.

reports.title: 旅游饭店星级的划分与评定 (Classification and Accreditation for Star-rated Tourist Hotels), GB/T 14308-2010
title_aliases: 旅游饭店星级的划分与评定
reports.publisher: 中国国家标准化管理委员会 (Standardization Administration of China)
reports.description: The recommended national standard that defines China's one-to-five-star hotel grades and the accreditation procedure behind them, GB/T 14308-2010, issued 2010-10-18 and effective 2011-01-01, replacing GB/T 14308-2003 in full; drafted by 国家旅游局监督管理司 under technical committee TC210 (全国旅游标准化技术委员会), 主管部门 文化和旅游部; reviewed 2016-12-31 with the conclusion 修订, and superseded in full by GB/T 14308-2023 from 2024-03-01. Statistical yearbooks use it to define the 星级饭店 series: a star-rated hotel is one whose 设备、设施、服务符合《旅游饭店星级的划分与评定》（GB/T14308-2010）标准 and has been accredited by the tourism authority. This node is the 2010 EDITION, on the GB/T 4754-2017 shape — each edition carries its own standard number and its own platform page — so a citation naming the number or year reaches it and a bare title does not (Suzhou's zb16, refused this round, could as well mean the 2023 edition in force for its data year). The cited page is the standard's own entry on SAMR's 全国标准信息公共服务平台 (std.samr.gov.cn), the national standards register, recording number, status, dates, the replaced and replacing editions, committee, drafters and 主管部门; HANDOFF 084's URL for this instrument was the platform's page for the 2020 revision PROJECT (20201806-T-357), not the standard. Minted round 43.
reports.cadence_note: A standing national standard, revised roughly once a decade: 1993, 1997, 2003, 2010, 2023. This node is the 2010 edition.

reports.title: 国家危险废物名录 (2016) (National Catalogue of Hazardous Wastes, 2016 edition)
reports.publisher: 生态环境部 (Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China; issued as 环境保护部 jointly with 国家发展和改革委员会 and 公安部)
reports.description: The 2016 edition of China's statutory list of hazardous wastes, made under the 固体废物污染环境防治法 and promulgated as 环境保护部、国家发展和改革委员会、公安部令第39号 on 2016-06-14, in force from 2016-08-01, repealing the 2008 edition (环境保护部、国家发展和改革委员会令第1号): 46 categories and 479 wastes coded by GB/T 4754-2011 industry of origin, with a new 危险废物豁免管理清单 annex. It is the reference that decides what counts as 危险废物 in environmental statistics, and the national statistical yearbook's 指标解释 for 危险废物产生量 says so with the edition year — 按《国家危险废物名录》（2016）填报. Later editions are separate instruments retitled with their year (国家危险废物名录（2021年版）, 生态环境部等五部门令第15号, from 2021-01-01; 国家危险废物名录（2025年版）, 令第36号, from 2025-01-01), so this node is the 2016 edition only and a bare 《国家危险废物名录》 (Jiangsu nj0914, refused this round) does not reach it. NODE CAVEAT on the URL: the Ministry's own 2016 page (mee.gov.cn/gkml/hbb/bl/201606/t20160621_354852.htm) now redirects to MEE's 404 page and its 规章库 lists only the 2025 edition, so the cited page is the State Council Gazette's printing of 令第39号 (国务院公报 2016年第26号 on gov.cn, the text and signatures in full, attachments omitted) — the same route as cn-foreign-contracted-projects-regulations; move the URL if MEE restores a page for this edition. MEE's interpretation of the edition is at https://www.mee.gov.cn/gkml/sthjbgw/qt/201606/t20160621_354849.htm. Minted round 43.
reports.cadence_note: A standing ministerial list, reissued as a new 令 roughly every five years (2008, 2016, 2021, 2025). This node is the 2016 edition.

reports.title: 人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度 (Human Resources and Social Security Statistical Survey System)
title_aliases: 人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度
reports.publisher: 人力资源和社会保障部 (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security's departmental statistical survey system (部门统计调查制度), formulated by the Ministry under the Statistics Law and approved by NBS: eleven full-coverage reporting surveys — petitions, employment, the human-resources market, vocational skills, talent in publicly-owned enterprises, personnel of public institutions, labour relations, wages and welfare of government bodies and institutions, social insurance, mediation and arbitration, and labour inspection — filled in by local HRSS departments, with monthly headline figures released through the Ministry's 数字人社 pages, the annual 人力资源和社会保障事业发展统计公报 by end-June, and 中国劳动统计年鉴. The national statistical yearbook's employment chapter names it as the source of its registered-unemployment series: 城镇登记失业人员数据，是人力资源社会保障部根据其《人力资源和社会保障统计调查制度》整理提供. The cited page is the instrument's own entry on NBS's 部门统计调查制度 listing (/fw/bmdcxmsp/bmzd/), the approving authority's register, carrying purpose, content, scope, method, organisation and release arrangements in full; the 2025-06-04 entry is the newer of the two on the listing (the other is 2023-02-15). NODE CAVEAT: the issuing body is the Ministry and the cited page is on the approving body's host (rule 19: authorship, not host) — move the URL if a mohrss.gov.cn page for the instrument is located. Found round 43 by matching the listing's 512 titles against re-fetched yearbook text without requiring 《》; the sentence had been swept past since round 29.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued periodically as a departmental survey system approved by NBS; the listing carries a 2023-02-15 and a 2025-06-04 edition.

reports.title: 企业会计准则——基本准则 (Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises — Basic Standard)
title_aliases: 企业会计准则——基本准则
reports.publisher: 财政部 (Ministry of Finance of the People's Republic of China)
reports.description: The Ministry of Finance's basic standard at the head of China's enterprise accounting system, promulgated as 财政部令第33号 on 2006-02-15 and in force from 2007-01-01, amended by 财政部令第76号 of 2014-07-23 (article 42(5), the fair-value definition, rewritten for convergence with IFRS). Its article 3 defines the system it heads — 企业会计准则包括基本准则和具体准则，具体准则的制定应当遵循本准则 — so the bare 《企业会计准则》 that statistical yearbooks name is the system, and the basic standard is its node (Thomas ruled 2026-09-10, round 43: one node, the basic standard). It is the full accounting basis beside the simplified 小企业会计准则, and yearbooks name the pair together: their 主要统计指标解释 for enterprise financial indicators (资产总计, 负债合计, 固定资产合计, 销售费用, 营业利润) tell the reader which line of the enterprise's own 资产负债表 or 利润表 to take 执行《企业会计准则》或《小企业会计准则》的企业. NODE CAVEAT on the URL: the Ministry's own pages for 令第76号 (tfs.mof.gov.cn/caizhengbuling/201407/t20140729_1119494.htm) and for the 2006 issue on kjs.mof.gov.cn answered 502 from the Ministry's CDN to the cloud container and to the built-in browser pane on 2026-09-10 (the kjs.mof.gov.cn page cited by cn-mof-small-enterprise-accounting-standards, read fine in round 42, 502'd the same way), so the cited page is the State Council Gazette's printing of 令第76号 with the amended 基本准则 in full (国务院公报 2014年第31号 on gov.cn) — the same route as cn-foreign-contracted-projects-regulations and cn-mee-hazardous-waste-list-2016; move the URL to the Ministry's page when it answers. MATCHER NOTE: the alias 企业会计准则 is a substring of 小企业会计准则, so a document naming only the small-enterprise standard would also satisfy namesTarget for this node — every edge here quotes a sentence naming both, and a future edge should do the same. Minted round 43 off three independent yearbook citations (Suzhou, Guangdong, Xi'an) after round 40 opened the lead.
reports.cadence_note: A standing standard, issued 2006 and amended once in 2014; not reissued on a cycle. The 42 specific standards beneath it are separate instruments.

Three editions of the standard exist with their own numbers and platform pages (GB/T 14308-2003, -2010, -2023), and for Suzhou's 2024 data year the 2023 edition was the one in force (from 2024-03-01) while the 2010 edition was 废止, so the bare title cannot say which edition it means. Same ground as the COICOP ruling (2026-09-08) and the bare 《三次产业划分规定》 refusals: the document must name the edition. The national yearbook names GB/T14308-2010 by number and that edge is live in this file. The round-41 `report_id`/`candidate_target` note in cn-round41-2026-09-09.json ('CITATION COUNT, not an edge', candidate id cn-mct-hotel-star-rating) described Suzhou's citation correctly and is not contradicted: the node now exists under the id cn-gbt-14308-2010 and Suzhou still has no edge to it. Also corrected here: HANDOFF 084 §3 item 1 listed Xi'an as a third citing document — all 22 of Xi'an's zbNN.pdf and its sm16/sm17 were fetched and grepped 2026-09-10 and none names the standard; the count is two documents (national, Suzhou), not three.

Four editions of the list exist as separate 令 (2008, 2016, 2021年版, 2025年版); for Jiangsu's 2024 data year the 2021 edition was in force and the 2025 edition took effect 2025-01-01, so the bare title cannot say which one it means and the 2016 edition this node is would be the least likely reading. The national yearbook's zb08 names the 2016 edition by year and that edge is live in this file. HANDOFF 084 §3 item 3 projected 'one node, two edges' and named the 2021 edition; the national citation is dated 2016 and Jiangsu's is undated, so it is one node, one edge.

GUANGDONG'S indicators.html LAYER IS SWEPT FOR UNBRACKETED NAMES — settled negative, 2026-09-10 (HANDOFF 084 §3 item 4). The CD-edition zip (stats.gd.gov.cn/attachment/0/615/615394/4810393.zip, 21,520,465 bytes, complete on the second `curl -C -` try after the first connection reset at 0 bytes) was extracted with GBK filenames decoded, and all 23 directory/NN/indicators.html plus the 24 brief-description.html were scanned for every sentence carrying 制度/办法/规定/方案/条例/标准/规范/名录/目录/准则 with or without 《》, and separately for every one of the 512 titles on NBS's 部门统计调查制度 listing with parenthetical editions stripped. Every bracketed title found is already wired (市场主体统计分类 ch01, GB/T 4754 + dated 三次产业划分规定 ch02, 建筑业 ch13, 批发和零售业 ch16, 住宿和餐饮业 ch17, 房地产开发 ch18, 大中小微型企业划分办法 ch12, 小企业会计准则 ch12) or already refused with a page-less publisher (机动车注册登记工作规范 ch15, 公路工程技术标准JTJ01-88 ch15, 2014年社会服务业统计制度 ch21).
